name: 120-Minute Nature Dose
title: Spend 120 minutes per week in nature.
subtitle: Weekly Recovery
rationale: Two hours a week in green space is the threshold where self-reported health and wellbeing measurably improve.

evidence.summary: In a large population study, 120-plus weekly minutes in nature associated with higher self-reported health and wellbeing, in any session pattern.

sources.label: 120 minutes in nature and wellbeing study

indications: Weeks pass entirely indoors between home, transit, and office.
Walks happen but only through built environments.
Stress stays elevated despite adequate sleep and training.
